name: bee_heat_ball
description: Japanese honeybee 'heat ball': a tight, opaque round ball of ~70 overlapping dark grey-brown bees with pale bands, all heads pointing inward, wings sticking out at angles; a smoky hornet wing tip and a sliver of orange hornet head peek out at the centre. Faint orange heat-shimmer lines at the sides. Anchor centre, radius ~280 (opaque disc r 262). Bold silhouette.
